morbi.headline: Tile export projections decline while Apollo Pipes targets ceramics expansion.
what_changed: Somany Ceramics projected an overall decline in tile exports to Rs 12,000-13,000 crore.
Apollo Pipes set a revenue target of Rs 1,000 crore for its ceramics business.
stress_signals: Projected fall in overall tile exports to Rs 12,000-13,000 crore points to potential export-market headwinds [202e1481c238]
improvement_signals: Apollo Pipes is targeting a sizable Rs 1,000 crore revenue base in the ceramics segment [a31fabfc72dc]
what_to_watch: Clarification on timelines, destination markets, and sub-segment impacts behind the projected export drop to Rs 12,000-13,000 crore.
Account-level order book volumes and export realization trends among export-oriented tile manufacturing units.
Details on Apollo Pipes' manufacturing footprint, partner tie-ups, and capacity rollout schedule to achieve the Rs 1,000 crore target.

surat.headline: Surat cluster sees mixed trends with falling input costs and surging diamond exports.
what_changed: Polyester FDY prices dropped 6.96% and staple fibre 4.33% alongside a 17% crude oil price drop [b6b6f83da93a, 71350aa24679].
Diamond units shortened their Diwali vacations from 25 days to 7 days due to improved orders [20dc10f35062, 5fc0b7b85616].
GJEPC reported a 96% surge in LGD exports and a 19% increase in natural diamond exports [ffee544acb58].
stress_signals: Inflation has curbed consumer buying, causing a slowdown and distress among local textile traders [0fed4a76da43].
A massive fire broke out at a textile waste godown requiring nine fire tenders [317f5c9fd10d].
improvement_signals: Gems and jewellery exports surged 34.01 percent ahead of Christmas driven by demand for studded gold and polished diamonds [c3b68570a07d].
IIT Madras selected Surat's MANTRA for a national textile sustainability project [8cfd965ad293].
what_to_watch: Monitor retail consumer demand and inflation trends impacting textile trader order books [0fed4a76da43].
Track sustainability project rollout progress for MANTRA [8cfd965ad293].
Observe inventory and working capital utilization across diamond units following reduced holiday breaks [20dc10f35062].
